brief: Money or meaning. You don't have to pick. How AI lets solo founders build things that pay AND matter without the venture capital trap.

slots.subtitle: How AI lets solo founders build profitable products that matter—without selling their soul to venture capital.
slots.preview1: Why the VC playbook is no longer the only path
slots.preview2: The AI stack that replaces a six-person team
slots.preview3: How to charge early and sleep soundly

slots.title: The new
slots.subtitle: AI collapses the cost of building. One founder now moves like six.
slots.insight1Body: Cloud inference costs less than one senior engineer's salary.
slots.insight2Body: Ship a working MVP in a weekend instead of a quarter.
slots.insight3Body: Rewrite entire features with a prompt, not a re-org.
slots.pullQuote: Venture capital used to buy manpower. Now it buys noise.

slots.title: One person,
slots.subtitle: The modern solo founder assembles a digital team that never sleeps.
slots.insight1Body: Generate brand assets, UI kits, and copy in an afternoon.
slots.insight2Body: AI pair-programming handles boilerplate, tests, and deploys.
slots.insight3Body: Agents answer tickets, triage bugs, and draft documentation.
slots.pullQuote: I don't have employees. I have an ensemble of models.

slots.title: Build for
slots.subtitle: A tiny, paying audience outperforms a million free users.
slots.insight1Body: Serve a specific pain point that enterprise tools ignore.
slots.insight2Body: Charge enough to matter, not enough to need a board.
slots.insight3Body: Revenue today means no pitch decks tomorrow.
slots.pullQuote: A hundred true fans at $50 a month is a living wage.

slots.title: Revenue
slots.subtitle: Monetize on day one. Let usage fund the roadmap, not runway.
slots.insight1Body: Collect credit cards before the final pixel is placed.
slots.insight2Body: Free trials create work; paid plans create feedback.
slots.insight3Body: If expenses are low, survival is a marketing problem.
slots.pullQuote: The best runway is a customer hitting subscribe.

slots.title: Meaning in
slots.subtitle: Profitability protects the purpose. You can't serve users from bankruptcy.
slots.insight1Body: No investors means no mandate to growth-at-all-costs.
slots.insight2Body: Your values scale implicitly through every product decision.
slots.insight3Body: Step off the VC track and build a company that fits your life.
slots.pullQuote: I wanted a business that whispered, not one that screamed for scale.

slots.title: Exit the
slots.subtitle: Redefine success as sovereignty. The goal is a life well funded and well lived.
slots.insight1Body: Unicorn odds are slim; lifestyle odds are certain.
slots.insight2Body: Small products stacked over years beat one big swing.
slots.insight3Body: Share the playbook and attract the next wave of indie builders.
slots.pullQuote: The real flex is owning your calendar and your code.

slots.ctaBody: Money and meaning aren't opposites. Build small, charge fairly, and own the work.
